name: Wizard
blurb: Bouncing fireballs that grow hotter, and a Frost Nova that freezes everyone nearby.

sfx.ultimate: icy crystalline blast with frosty shimmer

art.floor: dark blue stone floor tiles carved with faintly glowing magic runes
art.body: a wise wizard: a perfectly round royal blue ball body, a tall crooked purple wizard hat with a yellow star, a long flowing white beard, glowing white eyes under bushy brows
weapons: a gnarled wooden wizard staff with a glowing orange crystal orb at the right end

projectiles.fireball: a blazing fireball with a bright yellow core and an orange flame trail streaming to the left

art.ultimate_icon: a pale blue ice crystal snowflake bursting outward
art.ult_circle: an icy blue arcane circle with snowflake runes and frost crystals
art.ult_aura: a swirling frost and arcane aura with floating ice crystals and blue magic sparks
art.hit_fx: a shattering ice crystal burst with blue magic sparkles
